<title>SláinteCircle — Smart tools, safer tomorrows</title>
<style>

.life-activity-photo img{width:100%;height:250px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:16px}
.life-activity-photo h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:25px}.life-activity-photo p{color:var(--muted);margin:0}

/* My Health colour refinements: warm, clear and accessible */
#health .sectionhead h2{color:#124c42}
#health .dashboard>.panel:first-child{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff 0%,#fff7f5 100%);border-color:#f0c9c4}
#health .dashboard>.panel:nth-child(2){background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff 0%,#f2faf7 100%);border-color:#c8e5d8}
#health .dashboard>.panel:first-child .panelhead h2:before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:8px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;background:#d94841;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:10px}
#health .dashboard>.panel:nth-child(2) .panelhead h2:before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:8px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;background:#20a078;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:10px}
#health .quick{transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s,border-color .15s}
#health .quick:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px #163e2c12;border-color:#a4cdb9}
#health .quick:nth-child(1){background:#fff0ee;border-color:#f0c5c0}
#health .quick:nth-child(2){background:#eef5ff;border-color:#c8d8f4}
#health .quick:nth-child(3){background:#f4efff;border-color:#d8c9f5}
#health .quick:nth-child(4){background:#eaf8ee;border-color:#c5e6ce}
#health .quick:nth-child(1)>span{color:#b42318}
#health .quick:nth-child(2)>span{color:#245cb8}
#health .quick:nth-child(3)>span{color:#6c42a5}
#health .quick:nth-child(4)>span{color:#237747}
#health .listitem:nth-child(1) .icon{background:#fff0d9}
#health .listitem:nth-child(2) .icon{background:#e8efff}
#health .listitem:nth-child(3) .icon{background:#f5eaff}
#health .listitem:nth-child(4) .icon{background:#e4f6f0}
#health .listitem{padding:15px 10px;border-radius:12px;transition:background .15s}
#health .listitem:hover{background:#f8fbf9}
#health .listitem .pill{white-space:nowrap}
#health .listitem:nth-child(1) .pill{background:#fff0d9;color:#87520a}
#health .listitem:nth-child(2) .pill{background:#e8efff;color:#244e99}
#health .listitem:nth-child(3) .pill{background:#f5eaff;color:#6a3990}
#health .listitem:nth-child(4) .pill{background:#e4f6f0;color:#17684f}
#health .card{border-top:4px solid #cfe5d8}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(1){border-top-color:#6ab8a0}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(2){border-top-color:#e9b65b}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(3){border-top-color:#7b9fe3}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(4){border-top-color:#b69bdf}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(5){border-top-color:#e69b91}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(6){border-top-color:#78b9d1}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(1) .icon{background:#e3f6ef}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(2) .icon{background:#fff1d9}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(3) .icon{background:#eaf0ff}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(4) .icon{background:#f3eaff}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(5) .icon{background:#fff0ee}
#health .grid .card:nth-child(6) .icon{background:#e6f6fb}
#health #observationPanel{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff 0%,#f3f8ff 100%);border-color:#cbdaf1}
#health #appointmentsPanel{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff 0%,#fff9ec 100%);border-color:#f0dfb7}


/* Shared colour refinements for Home, My Health and Everyday Life */
:root{--green:#0b5948;--green2:#16745d;--mint:#e8f5ef;--cream:#fbf8f0;--ink:#17352e;--muted:#526a63;--orange:#f2a23a;--red:#b42318;--line:#d8e5de;--white:#fff;--shadow:0 10px 30px #163e2c12}
#home .hero-copy .eyebrow{background:#e5f5ed;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px}
#home .hero-photo{box-shadow:0 14px 34px #0b59481a}
#home .sectionhead{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#eaf7f0,#f4f8ff);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px}
#home .grid .card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-top:4px solid #cfe5d8}
#home .grid .card:nth-child(1){border-top-color:#e36b61;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff 0%,#fff4f2 100%)}
#home .grid .card:nth-child(2){border-top-color:#5cae94;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff 0%,#f0faf5 100%)}
#home .grid .card:nth-child(3){border-top-color:#e4b04d;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff 0%,#fff9eb 100%)}
#home .grid .card:nth-child(1) .icon{background:#fde3e0}
#home .grid .card:nth-child(2) .icon{background:#dff4e9}
#home .grid .card:nth-child(3) .icon{background:#fff0d0}
#home .feature-banner{box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0b59481a}
#life .hero-copy .eyebrow{background:#e5f5ed;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px}
#life .hero-photo{box-shadow:0 14px 34px #0b59481a}
#life .sectionhead{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff1dd,#f0f6ff);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px}
#life .foodgrid .card{border-top:4px solid #cfe5d8}
#life .foodgrid .card:nth-child(1){border-top-color:#e6b34f;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff 0%,#fff9eb 100%)}
#life .foodgrid .card:nth-child(2){border-top-color:#5eae91;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff 0%,#effaf5 100%)}
#life .foodgrid .card:nth-child(3){border-top-color:#8b82d7;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff 0%,#f5f2ff 100%)}
#life .foodgrid .card:nth-child(1) .foodemoji{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;background:#fff0d0;border-radius:15px;width:58px;height:58px}
#life .foodgrid .card:nth-child(2) .foodemoji{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;background:#dcf4e8;border-radius:15px;width:58px;height:58px}
#life .foodgrid .card:nth-child(3) .foodemoji{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;background:#e9e4ff;border-radius:15px;width:58px;height:58px}
#life .life-activity-photo{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,#fff5eb 100%);border-color:#f0dfc6}
#life .life-activity-photo .eyebrow{background:#fff0d8;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px}
#life .feature-banner{box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0b59481a}
.navlinks button.active{box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 #e9b65b}
.btn-primary{box-shadow:0 4px 0 #073d31}
.btn-secondary{border:1px solid #c8e4d7}
.card,.panel{transition:box-shadow .18s,border-color .18s}
.card:hover,.panel:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 32px #163e2c16}
.footer{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#103e33,#165846)}
@media(max-width:850px){#home .sectionhead,#life .sectionhead{padding:15px}}


/* Keep the complete Home hero photograph visible, including both people. */
#home .hero{align-items:start}
#home .hero-photo{align-self:start;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;min-height:0;height:auto;background:#f4f7f4}
#home .hero-photo img{object-fit:contain;object-position:center center;background:#f4f7f4}
@media(max-width:850px){#home .hero-photo{min-height:0;aspect-ratio:3/2}}


/* Home hero layout fix: avoid the empty right-hand area and keep the full photo visible. */
#home .hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:stretch}
#home .hero-copy{padding:18px 4px 0;max-width:900px}
#home .hero-photo{width:100%;height:auto;min-height:0;aspect-ratio:16/9;max-height:520px;background:#e8f2ed;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
#home .hero-photo img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center;background:#e8f2ed}
#home .hero-photo .photo-tag{bottom:14px;left:14px}
@media(max-width:600px){
  #home .hero-copy{padding:8px 0 0}
  #home .hero-photo{aspect-ratio:4/3;max-height:none}
}


/* Make the Home hero introduction use its full available width without feeling sparse. */
#home .hero-copy{max-width:none;width:100%;padding:18px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(280px,.9fr);column-gap:34px;align-items:start}
#home .hero-copy>.eyebrow{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:start;margin-bottom:4px}
#home .hero-copy>h1{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;margin:8px 0 12px;font-size:clamp(38px,4.3vw,54px)}
#home .hero-copy>p{grid-column:1;grid-row:3;margin:0;max-width:620px}
#home .hero-copy>.chips{grid-column:2;grid-row:2/4;align-self:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:12px;margin:4px 0}
#home .hero-copy>.chips .chip{font-size:17px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;display:block}
#home .hero-copy>.actions{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:4;margin-top:24px;gap:16px}
#home .hero-copy>.notice{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:5;margin-top:18px;max-width:none}
#home .hero-photo{margin-top:8px}
@media(max-width:700px){
  #home .hero-copy{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:0;row-gap:0}
  #home .hero-copy>.eyebrow{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto}
  #home .hero-copy>h1,#home .hero-copy>p,#home .hero-copy>.chips,#home .hero-copy>.actions,#home .hero-copy>.notice{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto}
  #home .hero-copy>.chips{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0 0}
  #home .hero-copy>.chips .chip{font-size:15px;padding:9px 12px}
  #home .hero-copy>.actions{margin-top:18px}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="topbar"><div class="wrap"><span>🇮🇪 Made for everyday wellbeing in Ireland</span><span>Healthcare is becoming more digital every day.</span></div></div>
<header class="nav"><div class="wrap navinner">
  <div class="brand"><span class="logo">☘</span> SláinteCircle</div>
  <nav class="navlinks" aria-label="Main navigation">
    <button class="active" data-view="home">⌂ Home</button><button data-view="health">♡ My health</button><button data-view="life">☀ Everyday life</button>
  </nav>
  <div class="profile"><img class="avatar" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Eileen Carroll profile photo"><span>Eileen Carroll<br><small style="font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)">Demo profile</small></span></div>
</div></header>

<main class="wrap">
<section class="view active" id="home">
  <div class="hero">
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <span class="eyebrow">● Your wellbeing, your way</span>
      <h1>Smart tech.<br>Safer tomorrows.</h1>
      <p>Simple tools to help you feel connected, keep track of your wellbeing and share what matters with the people you trust.</p>
      <div class="chips"><span class="chip">Big, clear buttons</span><span class="chip">Made for everyday use</span><span class="chip">Ireland-ready demo</span></div>
      <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-primary" data-go="health">♡ Open my health</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="checkinHero">✓ I'm okay today</button></div>
      <div class="notice"><strong>Demo only:</strong> this page does not contact emergency services, detect real falls, send SMS, order prescriptions or sync with medical devices. Never rely on it in an emergency.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-photo"><img alt="Older adults enjoying time together with technology" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="photo-tag">Keeping you connected and protected</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="sectionhead"><div><h2>What would you like to do?</h2><p>Choose a clear action to get started.</p></div><span class="status"><span class="dot"></span> Demo account ready</span></div>
  <div class="grid">
    <article class="card sos-card"><div class="icon">🆘</div><h3>Need help now?</h3><p>Open the emergency demo and see how a request for help could look.</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-danger" id="sosHome">SOS — Get help</button></div></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="icon">📝</div><h3>Record how I feel</h3><p>Make a note about symptoms, sleep, mood or changes you have noticed.</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" data-go="health" data-action="observation">Add observation</button></div></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="icon">💊</div><h3>Daily medication</h3><p>See a sample reminder and mark a dose as taken in this demo.</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" data-go="health" data-action="medication">View reminders</button></div></article>
  </div>
  <div class="feature-banner"><img alt="Donegal coastline, representing outdoor activity in Ireland" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="bannertext"><span class="eyebrow" style="color:#c3ead8">Active minds, digital hearts</span><h2>Make room for the good days.</h2><p>From a gentle walk to a new recipe, small everyday habits can support wellbeing. Explore simple ideas at your own pace.</p><button class="btn" style="background:#fff;color:var(--green)" data-go="life">Explore everyday life →</button></div></div>
</section>

<section class="view" id="health">
  <div class="sectionhead" style="margin-top:10px"><div class="health-greeting"><img class="health-avatar" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Eileen Carroll profile photo"><div><span class="eyebrow">♡ My health space</span><h2>Good to see you, Eileen.</h2><p>Sample information for Eileen Carroll · Donegal, Ireland</p></div></div><span class="demo-label">FICTIONAL DEMO DATA</span></div>
  <div class="dashboard">
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="panelhead"><h2>🆘 Need urgent help?</h2><span class="pill" style="background:#fde6e4;color:#9d2119">Emergency demo</span></div>
      <p>If this were a real emergency in Ireland, call <strong>112 or 999</strong>. This button only simulates an alert; it does not place a call or contact a monitoring centre.</p>
      <button class="big-sos" id="sosHealth">🆘 PRESS FOR HELP<small>Tap to view the simulated emergency steps</small></button>
      <div class="quickgrid">
        <button class="quick" id="fallDemo"><span>🛡️</span><strong>Fall alert demo</strong><small>Simulate an impact alert</small></button>
        <button class="quick" id="locationDemo"><span>📍</span><strong>My location</strong><small>View fictional location details</small></button>
        <button class="quick" id="trustedDemo"><span>👥</span><strong>Trusted contact</strong><small>Preview a contact alert</small></button>
        <button class="quick" id="checkinHealth"><span>✓</span><strong>Check in</strong><small>Let contacts know I'm okay</small></button>
      </div>
      <p class="helper">Real fall detection requires compatible hardware, testing and a reliable response service. A website alone cannot detect a physical fall.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="panelhead"><h2>Today at a glance</h2><span class="status"><span class="dot"></span> Demo</span></div>
      <div class="list">
        <div class="listitem"><div class="icon">💊</div><div><strong>Morning medication</strong><small id="doseStatus">Sample reminder · 9:00 am</small></div><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="doseTaken">Taken</button></div>
        <div class="listitem"><div class="icon">🩺</div><div><strong>Health appointment</strong><small>GP · Thu 29 Oct · 10:30 am</small></div><span class="pill">Upcoming</span></div>
        <div class="listitem"><div class="icon">📝</div><div><strong>Latest observation</strong><small id="latestObservation">No observation recorded in this session.</small></div><span class="pill amber" id="obsPill">Not added</span></div>
        <div class="listitem"><div class="icon">📲</div><div><strong>Device connection</strong><small>Phone and tablet sync is simulated locally.</small></div><span class="pill">Demo</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="openObs">＋ Add an observation</button><button class="btn btn-outline" id="openAppointments">＋ Add appointment</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sectionhead"><div><h2>My health tools</h2><p>Simple actions with clear next steps.</p></div></div>
  <div class="grid">
    <article class="card"><div class="icon">🎙️</div><h3>Medical observations</h3><p>Type a note or use voice dictation if your browser supports it. AI-style summary uses only the sample text you enter.</p><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="obsCard">Record observation</button></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="icon">⏰</div><h3>Medication reminders</h3><p>View the sample schedule and mark a reminder as taken. This does not verify actual medication use.</p><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="medCard">Open reminders</button></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="icon">📅</div><h3>Appointments</h3><p>Keep a simple list of appointments and what you want to ask.</p><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="apptCard">Manage appointments</button></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="icon">🔁</div><h3>Prescription request</h3><p>Prepare a request checklist to discuss with your GP or pharmacy.</p><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="prescriptionBtn">Prepare request</button></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="icon">☎️</div><h3>Contact my care team</h3><p>See the safe, manual contact options for your GP or local public health nurse.</p><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="careBtn">View contact options</button></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="icon">🔔</div><h3>Missed-entry indicator</h3><p>A missing diary entry is shown as incomplete, not as a diagnosis or proof of illness.</p><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="missedBtn">Preview indicator</button></article>
  </div>
  <div class="panel" id="observationPanel" style="margin-top:20px">
    <div class="panelhead"><h2>📝 Record an observation</h2><span class="demo-label">Sample only</span></div>
    <p>Record what happened in your own words. If you are worried about a new or worsening symptom, contact an appropriate healthcare professional; do not wait for an app summary.</p>
    <div class="field"><label for="obsText">What did you notice?</label><textarea id="obsText" placeholder="Example: I felt dizzy when I stood up after breakfast. It lasted about a minute."></textarea></div>
    <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="voiceBtn">🎙️ Dictate (if supported)</button><button class="btn btn-primary" id="summariseBtn">Create clear summary</button><button class="btn btn-outline" id="saveObs">Save note</button></div>
    <div class="helper" id="voiceStatus">Voice input depends on browser support and permission. Typed entry always remains available.</div>
    <div id="summaryBox" class="empty" style="margin-top:14px">Your summary will appear here. No medical diagnosis or treatment advice is generated.</div>
    <div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-outline" id="sharePreview">Preview message for care contact</button></div>
    <p class="helper">This prototype does not send texts, emails or GP messages. Any real sharing would require the person's consent, verified contact details and an agreed care process.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="panel hidden" id="appointmentsPanel" style="margin-top:20px">
    <h2>📅 Add an appointment</h2><div class="formrow"><div class="field"><label for="apptDate">Date</label><input type="date" id="apptDate"></div><div class="field"><label for="apptTime">Time</label><input type="time" id="apptTime"></div></div><div class="field"><label for="apptWith">Who is it with?</label><input id="apptWith" placeholder="e.g. GP, nurse, pharmacy"></div><div class="field"><label for="apptNotes">Questions to ask</label><textarea id="apptNotes" placeholder="Write down what you want to remember"></textarea></div><button class="btn btn-primary" id="saveAppt">Save sample appointment</button><div id="apptList" class="list" style="margin-top:14px"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="view" id="life">
  <div class="hero">
    <div class="hero-copy"><span class="eyebrow">☀ Everyday wellbeing</span><h1>Small steps.<br>Good days.</h1><p>Ideas for eating well, staying active and keeping your mind curious — at a pace that suits you.</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="dailyIdea">Give me an idea</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" data-go="home">Back to home</button></div><div class="notice">These are general wellbeing ideas, not personal medical advice. Follow any advice from your healthcare team.</div></div>
    <div class="hero-photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Older adults preparing food together in a kitchen"><div class="photo-tag">Enjoy life, your way</div></div></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="sectionhead"><div><h2>Choose your wellbeing moment</h2><p>Practical, gentle ideas for everyday life.</p></div></div>
  <div class="foodgrid">
    <article class="card"><div class="foodemoji">🥣</div><h3>Easy Irish-inspired food</h3><p>Simple meals with familiar ingredients. Adapt ingredients to your dietary needs.</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary recipeBtn" data-recipe="soup">Vegetable soup</button><button class="btn btn-outline recipeBtn" data-recipe="oats">Warm oats</button></div></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="foodemoji">🚶</div><h3>Keep gently active</h3><p>Try a short, familiar walk with suitable footwear, or seated movement if that is safer for you.</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="activityBtn">Show activity idea</button></div><div id="activityResult" class="helper"></div></article>
    <article class="card"><div class="foodemoji">🧩</div><h3>Keep your brain curious</h3><p>Enjoy a small challenge, a conversation or learning something new.</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="brainBtn">Try a quick brain teaser</button></div><div id="brainResult" class="helper"></div></article>
  </div>
  <div class="life-activity-photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Older adult enjoying a creative painting activity"><div><span class="eyebrow">🎨 Stay curious</span><h3>Make time for creativity.</h3><p>Painting, crafts and other hobbies can make a day more enjoyable. Choose an activity that feels comfortable and suits your interests.</p></div></div>
  <div class="feature-banner"><img alt="Scenic Donegal landscape in Ireland" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><div class="bannertext"><span class="eyebrow" style="color:#c3ead8">Your pace, your place</span><h2>Enjoy the outdoors safely.</h2><p>Explore a familiar, accessible route in Donegal with someone you trust. Check weather and local conditions before heading out.</p><button class="btn" style="background:#fff;color:var(--green)" id="walkBtn">Plan a gentle outing</button></div></div>
</section>
</main>

<footer class="footer"><div class="wrap footerinner"><div><strong style="font-size:22px">☘ SláinteCircle</strong><p>Keeping you connected and protected.</p><p>Active minds, digital hearts.</p></div><div><strong>Important safety note</strong><p>Student concept prototype using fictional information.</p><p>Not a medical device or emergency monitoring service.</p><p>In an emergency in Ireland, call 112 or 999.</p></div><div><strong>Privacy by design</strong><p>No data is sent to a server by this demo.</p><p>Do not enter real medical or personal information.</p></div></div><div class="wrap" style="border-top:1px solid #477466;margin-top:22px;padding-top:16px;text-align:center"><p>Created by <strong>Garreth Lopez</strong> · Student ID: <strong>25123289</strong></p></div></footer>

<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<div class="modalback" id="modalback" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modalTitle"><div class="modal"><h2 id="modalTitle">Demo</h2><div id="modalContent"></div><div class="modal-actions" id="modalActions"></div></div></div>

<script>
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>document.querySelectorAll(s);
function toast(msg){const t=$("#toast");t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add("show");clearTimeout(window.toastTimer);window.toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("show"),4300)}
function showModal(title,content,buttons=[{label:"Close",cls:"btn-primary",fn:closeModal}]){$("#modalTitle").textContent=title;$("#modalContent").innerHTML=content;const a=$("#modalActions");a.innerHTML="";buttons.forEach(b=>{const el=document.createElement("button");el.className="btn "+(b.cls||"btn-secondary");el.textContent=b.label;el.onclick=b.fn;a.appendChild(el)});$("#modalback").classList.add("show")}
function closeModal(){$("#modalback").classList.remove("show")}
$("#modalback").addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target.id==="modalback")closeModal()});
function go(view,action){$$(".view").forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle("active",v.id===view));$$(".navlinks button").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b.dataset.view===view));window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});if(action==="observation")setTimeout(()=>$("#obsText").focus(),250);if(action==="medication")setTimeout(()=>$("#doseTaken").focus(),250)}
$$("[data-view]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>go(b.dataset.view)));
$$("[data-go]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>go(b.dataset.go,b.dataset.action)));
function emergency(kind){showModal(kind==="fall"?"Fall alert — simulation":"SOS — emergency simulation",`<div class="notice"><strong>This is not a real alert.</strong> No emergency centre, responder or trusted contact has been contacted.</div><p><strong>Demo profile:</strong> Eileen Carroll</p><p><strong>Sample location:</strong> 12 Meadow View, Letterkenny, Co. Donegal (fictional address)</p><p><strong>Next step in a real service:</strong> confirm the person's safety, send a verified location to an agreed response service, and follow a tested escalation procedure.</p><p>If someone is in immediate danger in Ireland, call <strong>112 or 999</strong> directly.</p>`,[{label:"I'm safe — close",cls:"btn-secondary",fn:closeModal},{label:"Show trusted contact preview",cls:"btn-primary",fn:()=>{closeModal();trustedPreview()}}])}
$("#sosHome").onclick=()=>emergency("sos");$("#sosHealth").onclick=()=>emergency("sos");$("#fallDemo").onclick=()=>emergency("fall");
function trustedPreview(){showModal("Trusted contact alert — preview",`<p><strong>To:</strong> Trusted contact (sample contact, not configured)</p><p><strong>Message preview:</strong> “Eileen's demo profile has raised a check-in/fall alert. Please follow your agreed contact plan and verify her safety.”</p><p class="helper">No message is sent. A real service needs consent, a verified contact and clear response responsibilities.</p>`)}
$("#trustedDemo").onclick=trustedPreview;
$("#locationDemo").onclick=()=>showModal("Location — fictional sample",`<p><strong>Address:</strong> 12 Meadow View, Letterkenny, Co. Donegal</p><p><strong>GPS:</strong> Not accessed. This is made-up sample information.</p><p>A real location feature requires device permissions, accurate coordinates, secure handling and clear consent.</p>`);
function checkin(){toast("Demo check-in saved: Eileen is marked “I'm okay” for this session. No one has been notified.");}
$("#checkinHero").onclick=checkin;$("#checkinHealth").onclick=checkin;
$("#doseTaken").onclick=()=>{ $("#doseStatus").textContent="Marked taken in this demo session";$("#doseTaken").textContent="✓ Marked";$("#doseTaken").disabled=true;toast("Sample medication reminder updated locally. No medication data was verified.");};
function openObs(){go("health");$("#observationPanel").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});setTimeout(()=>$("#obsText").focus(),250)}
$("#openObs").onclick=openObs;$("#obsCard").onclick=openObs;
$("#medCard").onclick=()=>{go("health");$("#doseTaken").focus();toast("Sample medication reminder shown.");};
$("#apptCard").onclick=()=>{go("health");$("#appointmentsPanel").classList.remove("hidden");$("#appointmentsPanel").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});};
$("#openAppointments").onclick=$("#apptCard").onclick;
$("#prescriptionBtn").onclick=()=>showModal("Prescription request checklist",`<p>Use this checklist to contact your usual GP or pharmacy through their normal process:</p><ul><li>Check the medicine name and current supply.</li><li>Use the practice's or pharmacy's approved repeat-prescription process.</li><li>Do not change a dose based on this app.</li></ul><p>This demo does not send a prescription request.</p>`);
$("#careBtn").onclick=()=>showModal("Contact your care team",`<p>Use the phone number on your GP practice's official information or contact your local HSE service through its published contact details.</p><p>This prototype does not have a verified GP or public health nurse contact for Eileen. No contact details have been invented.</p><p><strong>Urgent emergency in Ireland:</strong> call 112 or 999.</p>`);
$("#missedBtn").onclick=()=>showModal("Missed-entry indicator",`<p><span class="pill amber">Entry not recorded</span></p><p>This means only that the expected diary entry is missing. It does not mean the person is unwell or has had a fall.</p><p>A real service would need an agreed schedule, accessible reminders and a clear process for deciding who—if anyone—should follow up.</p>`);
function getSummary(text){const clean=text.trim();if(!clean)return "";return "Observation recorded by Eileen: "+clean+(clean.endsWith(".")?"":".")+" This summary reflects the user's words only; it does not assess severity, diagnose a condition or recommend treatment."}
$("#summariseBtn").onclick=()=>{const s=getSummary($("#obsText").value);if(!s){toast("Please enter or dictate an observation first.");return}$("#summaryBox").textContent=s;toast("Plain-language summary created from your sample note.");};
$("#saveObs").onclick=()=>{const text=$("#obsText").value.trim();if(!text){toast("Please enter an observation first.");return}$("#latestObservation").textContent=text.length>72?text.slice(0,69)+"…":text;$("#obsPill").textContent="Recorded";$("#obsPill").className="pill";$("#summaryBox").textContent=getSummary(text);toast("Observation saved in this page session only.");};
$("#sharePreview").onclick=()=>{const text=$("#obsText").value.trim();if(!text){toast("Add an observation before previewing a message.");return}showModal("Care-contact message preview",`<p><strong>For review by Eileen's agreed care contact:</strong></p><blockquote>${escapeHTML(getSummary(text))}</blockquote><p class="helper">Nothing has been sent. The person should review the message and use an agreed, secure communication channel.</p>`,[{label:"Close",cls:"btn-primary",fn:closeModal}])};
function escapeHTML(s){return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]))}
$("#voiceBtn").onclick=()=>{const SR=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;if(!SR){$("#voiceStatus").textContent="Voice dictation is not supported by this browser. You can type your observation instead.";toast("Voice dictation is not available here.");return}const r=new SR();r.lang="en-IE";r.interimResults=false;r.onresult=e=>{$("#obsText").value+=(($("#obsText").value?" ":"")+e.results[0][0].transcript);$("#voiceStatus").textContent="Dictation added. Please review the words before saving."};r.onerror=()=>{$("#voiceStatus").textContent="Voice input did not complete. Please type your note instead."};r.start();$("#voiceStatus").textContent="Listening… speak clearly, then review the result."};
$("#apptDate").value="2026-10-29";$("#apptTime").value="10:30";
$("#saveAppt").onclick=()=>{const date=$("#apptDate").value,time=$("#apptTime").value,who=$("#apptWith").value.trim()||"Appointment",notes=$("#apptNotes").value.trim();if(!date||!time){toast("Please add an appointment date and time.");return}const item=document.createElement("div");item.className="listitem";const left=document.createElement("div");left.className="icon";left.textContent="📅";const mid=document.createElement("div");const strong=document.createElement("strong");strong.textContent=who;const small=document.createElement("small");small.textContent=date+" · "+time+(notes?" · "+notes:"");mid.append(strong,small);item.append(left,mid);$("#apptList").prepend(item);toast("Sample appointment added to this page session.");};
$("#dailyIdea").onclick=()=>showModal("Today's gentle idea",`<p>Pick one small thing: call someone you enjoy talking to, prepare a simple meal, or take a short walk on a familiar route if it is safe for you.</p>`);
$$(".recipeBtn").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const recipes={soup:["Simple vegetable soup","Simmer chopped carrots, onion, potato and other vegetables in low-salt stock until soft. Blend if preferred. Adapt for allergies and dietary advice."],oats:["Warm porridge oats","Cook oats with milk or a suitable alternative. Add soft fruit or cinnamon if you like. Follow any dietary advice you have been given."]};const r=recipes[b.dataset.recipe];showModal(r[0],`<p>${r[1]}</p><p class="helper">Check ingredient suitability for your own dietary needs.</p>`)});
$("#activityBtn").onclick=()=>$("#activityResult").textContent="Try 5–10 minutes of gentle movement that suits your ability. Stop if you feel unwell; follow your clinician's advice.";
$("#brainBtn").onclick=()=>{$("#brainResult").textContent="Brain teaser: What has keys but cannot open a door?";showModal("A little brain teaser",`<p>What has keys but cannot open a door?</p><p>Think for a moment, then reveal the answer.</p>`,[{label:"Reveal answer",cls:"btn-primary",fn:()=>showModal("Answer",`<p>A piano! 🎹</p>`)},{label:"Close",cls:"btn-outline",fn:closeModal}])};
$("#walkBtn").onclick=()=>showModal("Plan a gentle outing",`<p>Choose a familiar route, check the weather, carry a charged phone and let someone know your plan. In Donegal, check local access and conditions before setting out; this demo does not provide live route or weather information.</p>`);
</script>
</body></html>
